about: The one history reader's table (src/core2/past-history.ts; owner, Nov 25: "THE JOURNAL, DIRECTOR, PERSON CARDS, ETC ALL PULL FROM THE SAME HISTORY"). Which of a record's facts name the record that caused it, and which name the household or employer it belongs to. No record kind is named here: every source's rows are read by the same facts. A record with no place names its government by `jurisdictionFacts`: a state's key (US-UT) or the nation's (US).
